arxiv-1909-13231.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose Test-Time Training, a general approach for improving the performance of predictive models when training and test data come from different distributions. This also extends naturally to data in an online stream.

While quantum simulation is one of the most promising applications of modern quantum devices, accessible simulation times are fundamentally limited by finite coherence times due to omnipresent noise.
